Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

Class Inventory

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Inventory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rewindable
public final class Inventory extends Object implements Rewindable
The player's bag (GDD 1.4): 3 hotbar slots that take only consumables, 18 slots that take only passive items, the equipped weapon and the worn armor. Each slot holds one item; items never stack. The player always holds a weapon and wears an armor.

      public List<BuildModifier> getModifiers()

    • add

      public boolean add(Consumable consumable)
      Puts a consumable in the first free hotbar slot.
      Parameters:
      consumable - the consumable picked up
      Returns:
      true if it was put in a slot; false if the hotbar is full, so it stays on the ground
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if consumable is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if consumable is EMPTY_CONSUMABLE_SLOT

      public Consumable hotbarSlot(int index)

      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if index is outside 0 to HOTBAR_SIZE - 1

    • swapPassiveSlots

      public void swapPassiveSlots(int first, int second)
      Exchanges what two passive slots hold; with a free slot, the item moves there. The passive items apply in slot order, so swapping two of them changes the build.
      Parameters:
      first - one slot, from 0 to PASSIVE_SIZE - 1
      second - the other slot, from 0 to PASSIVE_SIZE - 1
      Throws:
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if a slot is outside 0 to PASSIVE_SIZE - 1

    • use

      public boolean use(int hotbarIndex, Character user)
      Uses the consumable of a hotbar slot (GDD 1.4, Q37). If it is spent, its slot is emptied; using an empty slot does nothing.
      Parameters:
      hotbarIndex - the slot, from 0 to HOTBAR_SIZE - 1
      user - the character who uses it
      Returns:
      true if a consumable was spent; false if the slot was empty or the consumable was kept
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if user is null
      IndexOutOfBoundsException - if hotbarIndex is outside 0 to HOTBAR_SIZE - 1

      Swaps the equipped weapon for a new one (GDD 1.4). The player always holds a weapon, so the old one is given back for the world to drop on the ground.

      Returns:
      the weapon that was equipped before
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if newWeapon is null
